mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.member_id AS memberId, s.plan_id AS planId, m.name AS memberName, p.plan_name AS planName, p.monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, DATE_FORMAT(s.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(s.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, s.status, DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM subscription s JOIN member m ON s.member_id = m.id JOIN plan p ON s.plan_id = p.id ORDER BY s.created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{limit}

SELECT s.id, s.member_id AS memberId, s.plan_id AS planId, m.name AS memberName, p.plan_name AS planName, p.monthly_fee AS monthlyFee, DATE_FORMAT(s.start_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate, DATE_FORMAT(s.end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate, s.status, DATE_FORMAT(s.created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS createdAt FROM subscription s JOIN member m ON s.member_id = m.id JOIN plan p ON s.plan_id = p.id WHERE s.id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO subscription (member_id, plan_id, start_date, end_date, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{planId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, COALESCE(#{status}, 'ACTIVE'))
